class.name: WorkerTaskQueue
class.brief_description: Multithreaded FIFO of tasks on worker threads of its own.
class.description: Runs submitted [Callable]s on [code]max(processor count - 2, 1)[/code] worker threads of its own, started with the first task - never Godot's [WorkerThreadPool], which the engine's own loading waits for: a task there that waits for the main thread (a mesh read back from the [RenderingServer]) deadlocks it. A task may submit further tasks and [method wait] for them: the waiting thread runs queued tasks meanwhile, so nested waiting does not deadlock. Used by [code]SceneryInstancer[/code] to parse every scenery include as a separate task, by [SceneryStreamingServer] to preload what it streams, and to read vehicle profiles. Queued tasks are dropped when the queue is freed; the queue must not be freed by its own task.

method.name: get_submitted_count
method.description: Number of tasks submitted so far, including those submitted by other tasks.

method.name: is_done
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the task has finished and its result can be taken with [method wait] without blocking.

method.name: submit
method.description: Queues [param task] ([code]task() -> Variant[/code]) and returns its id.

method.name: wait
method.description: Returns the result of the task and forgets it. Until the task is done, the calling thread runs other queued tasks.
